articles.title: Kerim Alajbegovic insists he did not think twice about a move to Juventus
articles.summary: Kerim Alajbegovic was one of the most wanted players in Europe during the last transfer window after his superb season at RB Salzburg, and Bayer Leverkusen e...
articles.body:
Kerim Alajbegovic was one of the most wanted players in Europe during the last transfer window after his superb season at RB Salzburg, and Bayer Leverkusen exercised their buy-back clause to take him back to Germany.

However, he was never expected to stay with Leverkusen because of the interest in his signature, and Chelsea were close to adding him to their squad. The Blues are an attractive team that could probably have offered him better wages than he earns at Juventus , but he ultimately decided to move to the Bianconeri .

Juventus are the biggest club in Italian football and, to many people, have a stronger standing than Chelsea, so the decision was not particularly difficult for Alajbegovic.

The attacker has now reflected on his decision and insists that as soon as Juventus made an offer for his signature, he knew they would be his next club.

Alajbegovic has enjoyed his start to life at Juventus and appears pleased with the decision to move to Turin. His comments suggest that the opportunity to join the Bianconeri was enough to convince him, despite interest from elsewhere.

Chelsea's interest meant that Alajbegovic had another option available, but Juventus ultimately secured his signature. The attacker has now explained that he did not need much time to decide once Juve entered the race.

(Photo by Richard Heathcote/Getty Images)

Alajbegovic has spoken positively about the decision and explained why Juventus were such an obvious choice for him when they made their interest known.

"When you have an offer from Juventus, you don't think twice, you have to go.

"In the end it was a really good decision for me. The Juventus fans are fantastic, they give us more energy."

The comments show how quickly Alajbegovic settled on Juventus as his preferred destination. Despite Chelsea's interest, the attacker knew where he wanted to continue his career once the Bianconeri made their approach.

His positive start at Juventus has also given him further reason to be pleased with his decision. Fan support has added to his experience, and he is now looking forward to continuing his career with the Italian club.

articles.title: Santos FC and Leão do Mar hold beach clean-up with EcoFaxina
articles.summary: Santos FC wrapped up the launch week of the Leão do Mar Institute with a cleanup of José Menino beach in Santos, supported by the EcoFaxina Institute. The in...
articles.body:
Santos FC wrapped up the launch week of the Leão do Mar Institute with a cleanup of José Menino beach in Santos, supported by the EcoFaxina Institute. The initiative took place this Sunday (27) and included the participation of administrative manager Luiz Fernando Vella, Leão do Mar Institute president Patrícia Gorisch, organized supporters, Scouts of Brazil, the Sereias da Vila, and male and female youth players.

Luiz Fernando Vella highlighted the work carried out in partnership with the Institute. "The launch week of the Leão do Mar Institute was busy and full of care for the environment and the community, which is at the heart of what we envision for the project. Today, with the EcoFaxina Institute, we are able to conclude this first stage, and there is no place more symbolic than our beach in Santos. We will continue in partnership with the Leão do Mar Institute, certain that we are building a brilliant legacy for future generations."

Leão do Mar Institute president Patrícia Gorisch was present and took part in the initiative. "All of our coastal cities end up feeling the effects of this degradation. And the importance of this cleanup action is to make an impact on the children and adults who were there. At first, the beach seems clean, but it is only a partial cleanup. To the naked eye, everything looks fine, until we start pulling out a buried straw, a bottle cap, and PET bottle waste. We combed the beach from nine to eleven, and in two hours we filled buckets with microplastics."

There were 117 volunteers present at the 213th cleanup action carried out by the EcoFaxina Institute, collecting 5,554 pieces of waste, for a total of 34.55 kg.

William Rodriguez Schepis, president of the EcoFaxina Institute, celebrated everyone's involvement. "Nearly 60% of the weight collected is plastic, and two-thirds of the items are fragments, pieces already broken down by the sun and the sea, on their way to becoming microplastics. Having the Sereias, the Meninos da Vila, and the scouts from the region side by side shows the mobilizing power that Santos has and what it can do for the coast. We will now bring this same approach inside Vila Belmiro, with a waste management and environmental education project together with the fans. And we will keep moving forward through forest citizenship, also embracing our mangroves."

articles.title: At Instituto Leão do Mar launch penultimate day, Santos FC frees wildlife
articles.summary: Santos FC took part, together with the Instituto Leão do Mar, in the release of wild animals at the Fazenda do Carmo Municipal Natural Park, the first fully...
articles.body:
Santos FC took part, together with the Instituto Leão do Mar, in the release of wild animals at the Fazenda do Carmo Municipal Natural Park, the first fully protected conservation unit in the city of São Paulo, inaugurated in 2003. Along with the action carried out this Saturday (26), an ecological trail walk was held with scouts, Santos FC board members, youth academy athletes, organized supporters, and the mascots Baleinha and Leo.

The preservation area, located in the East Zone of São Paulo, is essential for the entire municipality, serving as a foundation for water production, thermal comfort, high-quality oxygen, the conservation of fauna and flora, and encouragement for scientific research and environmental education across a total of 573 hectares.

"The city of São Paulo could not be left out of the Institute's actions, because it is where we have our largest concentration of the Club's supporters and because of the full significance of the state capital before Brazil and the world. This is another very positive event, and it helps strengthen the Instituto Leão do Mar brand through practical actions," commented Ricardo Novaes, vice president of the Instituto Leão do Mar.

The rehabilitation of wild animals is carried out at the Wild Animal Management and Conservation Center, CeMaCAS. After rehabilitation, the release is conducted by the Wild Fauna Division in São Paulo's fully protected conservation units.

"The animals we released today have already gone through quarantine and a series of blood tests to check for any kind of pathology. If there was any, it was treated, and then they were trained for rehabilitation," commented Thiago de Andrade, public facility manager and the person responsible for the site.

The site is open to the public for visits from Tuesday to Sunday, from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

articles.title: Liverpool scouts regularly attend games to watch 'fast' wonderkid
articles.summary: Liverpool have their eyes on a lot of players ahead of the January transfer window. The Anfield outfit made four new signings in the summer and, while all of...
articles.body:
Liverpool have their eyes on a lot of players ahead of the January transfer window.

The Anfield outfit made four new signings in the summer and, while all of them have managed to improve the Reds' ranks, it's clear that some more changes still need to be made.

That's because there are still a fair few areas among their ranks that are lacking in depth with some of their starters even failing to perform to the standards expected.

Obviously, they can't go out and spend another £150 million but, if they see a market opportunity or desperately need to bring someone new in for one of their current players, there's no doubt that Liverpool will make their move.

So, the fact that their scouts are being sent out to watch several players across the globe on a regular basis is hardly surprising.

Liverpool are regularly watching Givairo Read

One of Liverpool's main problem positions last term was their right-back.

Jeremie Frimpong and Conor Bradley were both consistently side-lined due to injury which resulted in Dominik Szobsoszlai, Wataru Endo and Curtis Jones all being used as a full-back.

Obviously, Joe Gomez would've been the best player for them to use there but, since he's also rather injury prone, he was barely ever available for selection either.

This led to Ronald Araujo being signed by Liverpool and, even though he's doing a solid job as Iraola 's right-back, the Reds' €55 million option to buy may end up feeling a tad too steep for them to activate.

That is, especially since the Uruguayan will be 28 years old next June.

Many different right-backs have been linked, however, according to FR Fans, Liverpool's eye may be on one full-back in particular.

"In Rotterdam, the financial rule is often that you have to sell to grow. But with the intense English interest in Givairo Read and Gjivai Zechiël, Technical Director Dévy Rigaux will soon face a problem," they wrote .

"After all, what do you do if the Premier League comes knocking for both players in January?

"The English rumour mill is running at full speed. Scouts from Liverpool, Arsenal , and Manchester City regularly sit in the stands to watch Read, while the list of clubs interested in Oranje squad debutant Zechiël is also growing longer.

"Together, the two Rotterdammers now represent well over 60 million euros.

"Although such a mega-deal would cause the bank account at De Kuip to explode in one fell swoop, a departure midway through the season would completely destroy Giovanni van Bronckhorst 's team."

Givairo Read could be the perfect successor for Trent Alexander-Arnold

Although Araujo has helped improve Liverpool's defence, going forward, he's far from the best.

Obviously, the 27 year olds natural position is as a centre-back so, on the attack, there are certainly some improvements he could make.

There have been times this season when he's tried to run down the by-line and ping the ball into the box but, more often than Liverpool would like, he's never made it past the first man.

This is obviously a problem as, even though Iraola uses wingers in his system, he also relies on his full-backs to create chances, as proven with Milos Kerkez at Bournemouth .

So, in reality, Trent Alexander-Arnold would have been perfect for the Spaniard. However, since that ship has now sailed, Liverpool are going to have to turn their attention elsewhere, which is where Read comes in.

The " fast " Dutchman is only 20 years old so, while he may not be a finished product just yet, the talent that he has proven he already has is second-to-none.

In attack or in defence, he's quickly become one of Feyenoord's most important players and, since the Eredivisie outfit are often a club who sells their most talented players, a deal could definitely be struck in the future.

Here's hoping that Liverpool manage to get this deal over the line and beat other teams such as Bayern Munich and Manchester City to his transfer.

articles.title: 2012 Recopa Sul-Americana: Centenário's international title
articles.summary: Gabriel Pierin, from the Memory CenterOn September 26, Santos celebrates the anniversary of winning the 2012 South American Recopa, when it defeated Universi...
articles.body:
Gabriel Pierin, from the Memory Center On September 26 , Santos celebrates the anniversary of winning the 2012 South American Recopa, when it defeated Universidad de Chile in front of a packed Pacaembu. The title added even more value to the 2011 Libertadores triumph and completed the fans' celebrations in Santos' Centenary year.

The 2012 South American Recopa was Peixe's second title in the competition and the first under the format that pitted the champions of the Copa Libertadores against the winners of the Copa Sudamericana. The previous triumph, in 1968, came under a different format: the competition brought together South American world champions, who competed for a place in the Intercontinental Recopa against European teams. Afterwards, Santos also lifted the world trophy, defeating Internazionale of Milan.

The 2012 Recopa was played over two matches. The first leg took place at the home of the Copa Sudamericana champions, while the return leg was held at the stadium of the Copa Libertadores champions.

In Chile, around 45,000 people packed the National Stadium to cheer on "La U." Despite the pressure from the home crowd, Santos controlled the action in the first half and created several chances to open the scoring. The best of them came from the penalty spot, but Neymar missed after slipping at the moment of the shot.

In the second half, the match became more balanced. Universidad de Chile began to press, while Santos found space on the counterattack. Neither team, however, managed to find the net. The goalless draw took the decision to São Paulo, where Santos fans were already preparing a big celebration at the Pacaembu.

All the ingredients were there for a great final. The club's Centenary and the recent Campeonato Paulista title had rallied the fans, who packed the Paulo Machado de Carvalho Stadium.

Managed by Muricy Ramalho, Santos took the field with Rafael, Bruno Peres (Éwerton Páscoa), Bruno Rodrigo, Durval , Léo (Gérson Magrão), Adriano, Arouca, Felipe Anderson , Patito Rodríguez (Miralles), Neymar and André. On the other side was a Universidad de Chile side led by a name that, years later, would become familiar to Santos fans: Jorge Sampaoli.

The match began tensely, with the Chilean team looking dangerous and creating the best chances in the opening minutes. In the 27th minute, however, Santos found the breakthrough. Léo intercepted a long pass in his own half, nutmegged his marker, and played Felipe Anderson down the left flank. After driving forward, the midfielder found Neymar at the edge of the box. The Menino da Vila combined with André and finished into goalkeeper Johnny Herrera 's right corner, scoring a beautiful goal and opening the scoring in the final.

Still in the first half, the attacking trio of Felipe Anderson, Neymar and Patito Rodríguez continued to trouble Universidad de Chile's defense, but they were unable to turn their chances into more goals.

In the second half, Santos kept up the pressure. In the 15th minute, after a free kick was sent into the box, Bruno Rodrigo rose highest and headed the ball into the net, doubling the black-and-white side's lead and giving Santos greater peace of mind, as a team used to playing in major finals.

Until the final minutes, the Meninos da Vila remained in control of the match and confirmed Santos' superiority. The victory gave Santos the ninth official international title in its history, fittingly in its Centenary year.

It was also the sixth title in three years for that generation led by Neymar and Ganso , a team that left its mark on the history of Santos and of Brazilian and world football.

articles.title: Colts news: Sauce Gardner hilariously lauds DeForest Buckner's dominance
articles.summary: The Indianapolis Colts entered the win column on Sunday after beating the Houston Texans, 19-17, at Lucas Oil Stadium. The Colts ended their nine-game losing...
articles.body:
The Indianapolis Colts entered the win column on Sunday after beating the Houston Texans , 19-17, at Lucas Oil Stadium. The Colts ended their nine-game losing streak dating back to last season.

Spencer Shrader scored the game-winning field goal from 53 yards with 16 seconds left.

DeForest Buckner was also key in the much-needed victory, tallying seven total tackles, including one for loss, 1.5 sacks, and two quarterback hits.

Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial)

Sauce Gardner was so impressed with Buckner during the game that he stopped doing his job for a bit, as revealed by ESPN's Stephen Holder.

"Colts cornerback Sauce Gardner said he was marveling at DT (defensive tackle) DeForest Buckner's performance on Sunday, so much so, 'I was just looking in the backfield' during some plays. But he quickly admitted, 'As a cornerback, you shouldn't be doing that,'" wrote Holder on X.

It was a candid admission by Gardner, who finally won in the United States after 647 days.

Holder noted that the 25-year-old Gardner has been a pleasure to talk to because of his openness, not to mention his sense of humor.

"People have lots of opinions about Sauce, but I want to say he has been such a professional in his dealings with the media and is so affable and honest. I really, really enjoy talking to him," added Holder.

Gardner and Buckner will continue to be key enforcers as the Colts try to tighten up their defense after allowing an average of 37 points in their first two games. Obviously, limiting the Texans to below 20 points was a step in the right direction.

The Colts will travel to London in Week 4 to face the Washington Commanders .

articles.summary: Nehpal Singh is basking in the glory as the coach of Vithya Ramraj who bettered PT Usha's 42-year-old record, three years after equalling that elusive
articles.body: Nehpal Singh is basking in the glory as the coach of Vithya Ramraj who bettered PT Usha's 42-year-old record, three years after equalling that elusive record in the women's 400m hurdles at the last Asian Games in Hangzhou.Asked about the five-year plan, which took Indian athletics to a new high with his ward dipping under the 55-second and lowering the new mark to 54.75 seconds, the coach from Rajasthan, whose family is settled in Salem for the last 20 years, said: "Vithya would have set the record last year itself but for the injury at the Asian championships. She sustained a serious ankle injury but ran with the swollen ankles at the Asian meet and still won the bronze.This year I was waiting eagerly for everything to go right and today she did it.""I knew she would peak in this competition. I was almost sure that she would do sub 54.5, but it was 54.7. But it is okay because, without progression, you cannot perform at that big level. At the Delhi meet on Sep 10, she fell down from a hurdle; otherwise, we were expecting around 55.0s there and then the progression from there (to the National record)," the former national-level sprinter turned coach Nehpal told TOI from Nagoya.Asian Games Full Coverage | Medal Tally | ScheduleAsked about the sacrifices made by the 28-year-old from Coimbatore, he said: "She is very dedicated. Both of us have not gone home all year as we were training fully focussed on the big meet."Nehpal, who started coaching her in 2021 and holds a World Athletics coaching certification, lauded Vithya for her dedication. "Vithya is the most consistent athlete. She has been in the top 3 in India in the 400m for the last five years. And for the last five years, she's been No. 1 in the 400m hurdles.""The day she asked me, 'I want to join you for training,'... I was like, yes, we can do. Okay. We can do this national record. Once the national record was equaled, I realized she could do much more. My plan was sub 55. And this year, we figured out that no, we can go sub 54," said Nehpal who also trains Vithya's twin sister Nithya. Nithya, who is recovering from an injury, had finished seventh in the 100m hurdles at the last Asiad.Moving forward, the coach and Vithya have set their sights on the World Championships and the LA Games."The qualification mark for the World Championships and Olympics is 54.0s. articles.title: Tyson Fury Willing To Fight The 'Monster' If Anthony Joshua Pulls Out
articles.summary: Tyson Fury says David Benavidez is an option if Anthony Joshua misses their Dec. 11 Cardiff date. Benavidez has already agreed to face Jai Opetaia on May 5.
articles.body:
Tyson Fury seems determined to keep his December date in Cardiff — even if his desired opponent Anthony Joshua pulls out. We finally got a date, location and viewing information for Fury-Joshua , but the former is seemingly already preparing for what might happen if his rival isn't available. According to Fury, he's willing to fight light heavyweight-cruiserweight KO artist, David Benavidez. Let's talk boxing.

WBA and WBO cruiserweight, WBC light heavyweight

Jai Opetaia, agreed for May 5 in Las Vegas

Benavidez isn't unattached. After Jai Opetaia stopped Noel Mikaelian in the ninth at T-Mobile Arena on September 13, Opetaia called him into the ring and the two agreed to fight on May 5 in Las Vegas. Benavidez is also a three-division champion — he took a 25-pound jump to stop Gilberto Ramirez in six for the WBA and WBO cruiserweight belts in May.

I won't go as far as to say Fury-Benavidez is a more intriguing fight than Fury-Joshua. After all, we've waited more than a decade for this fight. However, I can say that it wouldn't be a tough sell to boxing fans outside of the UK. British boxing fans probably won't settle for anything less than Fury-Joshua. The two men are the most iconic heavyweights from the country since Lennox Lewis. However, in the United States and elsewhere, Fury-Benavidez feels like a dream matchup that most probably wouldn't imagine they'd get a chance to watch.

Benavidez was a huge super middleweight and a relatively large light heavyweight. He's big enough at cruiserweight to make you wonder if he could be effective as a heavyweight. It's interesting.

That said, it makes more sense for Benavidez to clash with current cruiserweight king, Jai Opetaia. Benavidez got in the ring after Opetaia stopped Noel Mikaelian earlier this month. That's the fight to make for Benavidez. Then if he or Opetaia want to test their strength at heavyweight, the move up would be more sensible.

There's a void in the ACC for a No. 2 team behind Miami, and the Friday night winner between Pitt and Virginia Tech will have a leg up on the rest of the conference.
